cases.given: The sources report observations, while the requested conclusion requires interpretation and uncertainty.
cases.expect: A readable conclusion whose evidence, inference, and uncertainty remain distinguishable.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a single atomic transformation has no phase transition
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A transition cannot increase certainty beyond its evidence without an explicit warrant.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A source fact is used to support a probabilistic recommendation.
cases.expect: The skill records and labels the transition rather than presenting the recommendation as quoted fact.
cases.reject: The skill either mixes statuses silently or walls phases off without checking consistency.
